title: See what changed in past edits

entries.text: See what changed in past edits

Every edit in markoto is logged in the Activity tab, who, when, how many lines added or removed. Click any row to expand a diff drawer in place: green added lines, red removed, line numbers, git-style `@@` hunks. Read-only by default; the Restore button is one click further if you want to roll back.

entries.caption: The Activity feed opens, one row per edit, comment, restore, theme/title change.

entries.text: Click any edit row to see the diff
Edit rows are clickable, chevron + "show details" hint. The diff drawer expands inline; the editor stays where it is. No modal, no navigation. Click again to collapse.

entries.caption: Click the row to expand its diff
The diff drawer expands inline, green for added lines, red for removed, line numbers down the gutter.
